tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background of the site, README graphics and the social card. Dark value is the brand navy the mark was drawn on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks and panels that sit on `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, table headers, the inside of a card that is itself on `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised` (≥14:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table notes on `ground` and `surface` (7.9:1 dark · 5.6:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled marks only. Fails 4.5:1 as text (3.2:1 dark · 2.8:1 light) — kept exact from the Studio source; never set readable copy in it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the focus ring, the lead (third) chevron, the one emphasised word in a headline. 7.0:1 on `ground` dark · 7.1:1 on `surface` light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (primary button).

tokens.name: wordmark-ink
tokens.usage: The "Crew" half of the wordmark. Also display headlines when they sit beside the logo.

tokens.name: wordmark-accent
tokens.usage: The "forth" half of the wordmark. Display sizes only (24px+): the light value is 4.5:1 on white and just under on `ground` light (4.2:1).

tokens.name: chevron-1
tokens.usage: First (rear) chevron of the mark; the lightest block on the cover.

tokens.name: chevron-2
tokens.usage: Second chevron of the mark; mid block on the cover.

tokens.name: chevron-3
tokens.usage: Third (lead) chevron — the crew's direction. Always the accent.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Fixed ground of the app icon, favicon and social card in BOTH themes — the mark always sits on navy there.

tokens.name: studio-accent
tokens.usage: Studio panel only: selection and live-session highlight. 3.2:1 on white — marks, not light-theme text.

tokens.name: status-busy
tokens.usage: Studio: an agent running a tool. Pair with its label; never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Studio: an agent parked on an approval. Pair with its label.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Studio: an agent with nothing to do. Pair with its label.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Studio: a passed gate or finished agent. Pair with its label.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Studio: a refused gate or warning. Orange, not red, so it separates from `status-good` beyond hue.

tokens.name: status-fail
tokens.usage: Studio: a failed agent or run; text-safe on its own `ground` in each theme.

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Reference only: the shipped logos are outlined paths at this setting. Never retype the logo.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Your engineering crew for Claude Code.
styles.usage: One per page: the landing headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A destructive command is refused before it runs; a commit waits for your approval.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: From first idea to production · 12 specialists · gates that hold

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase stage and section labels: Understand · Produce · Audit · Close · Hand off.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; chip padding (block).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding (inline); gap between badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and code-block padding; the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its section body blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on the site.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Above and below the landing hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, inline code, Studio agent-state pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, buttons, the Studio panel's panes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large media frames (the Studio GIF on the site).

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile (46 on the 200 grid). Use only for the icon.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons and the version badge.
